Residence: type of residence area where the patient lives (City, Village, etc.)
Education Level: highest education level achieved by the patient
Occupation before latest pregnancy: occupation of the patient before her most recent pregnancy
Monthly income before latest pregnancy: monthly income level of the patient before her most recent pregnancy
Occupation After Your Latest Childbirth: occupation of the patient after giving birth
Current monthly income: current monthly income level of the patient
Husband's education level: highest education level achieved by the patient's husband
Husband's monthly income: monthly income level of the patient's husband
Addiction: whether the patient has any addiction
Total children: total number of children the patient has
Disease before pregnancy: whether the patient had any disease before pregnancy
History of pregnancy loss: whether the patient has a history of pregnancy loss
Family type: type of family structure (Nuclear, Joint, etc.)
Number of household members: number of people living in the patient's household
Relationship with the in-laws: quality of the patient's relationship with her in-laws
Relationship with husband: quality of the patient's relationship with her husband
Relationship with the newborn: quality of the patient's relationship with her newborn baby
Relationship between father and newborn: quality of the relationship between the father and the newborn
Feeling about motherhood: patient's emotional feeling about being a mother
Recieved Support: level of support received by the patient
Need for Support: level of need for additional support expressed by the patient
Major changes or losses during pregnancy: whether the patient experienced major changes or losses during pregnancy
Trust and share feelings: whether the patient can trust others and share feelings
Number of the latest pregnancy: number of the patient's most recent pregnancy
Pregnancy length: duration or length of the pregnancy
Regular checkups: whether the patient had regular medical checkups during pregnancy
Fear of pregnancy: whether the patient experienced fear related to pregnancy
Diseases during pregnancy: whether the patient had any diseases during pregnancy
Age of newborn: age category of the newborn baby
Age of immediate older children: age category of the patient's immediate older children
Mode of delivery: method of childbirth delivery (Normal Delivery, Caesarean Section, etc.)
Birth compliancy: whether there were any complications during birth
Breastfeed: whether the patient breastfeeds the newborn
Newborn illness: whether the newborn has any illness
Worry about newborn: whether the patient worries about the newborn
Relax/sleep when newborn is tended: whether the patient can relax or sleep when the newborn is being tended by others
Relax/sleep when the newborn is asleep: whether the patient can relax or sleep when the newborn is asleep
Angry after latest child birth: whether the patient feels angry after the latest childbirth
Feeling for regular activities: patient's feeling or ability to perform regular activities
target: postpartum depression status (0 - does not have postpartum depression, 1 - has postpartum depression)
